description: Image Description: The image shows a fruit stand displaying bunches of bananas. There are two types of bananas on display: regular bananas and baby bananas. The baby bananas are in the lower section, with a price sign reading "$1.49 per pound." The bananas are organized neatly in rows, and each bunch has a sticker on it.
